title: Evidence
description: Evidence. Class-level properties describe the evidence type/category. Instance-level properties describe a concrete piece of evidence recorded at a specific time, linking observations to beliefs.

id.description: [instance-level] Stable identifier for this evidence record.

run_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the run this evidence belongs to.

agent_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the agent that recorded this evidence.

timestamp_s.description: [instance-level] Simulated time in seconds when the evidence was recorded.

version.description: [class-level] Schema version of the evidence record format.

observation_ids.description: [instance-level] Identifiers of observations that constitute this evidence.

supports_fact_id.description: [class-level] Identifier of the ground-truth fact this evidence supports.

supports_belief_ids.description: [instance-level] Identifiers of beliefs this evidence supports.

examples.description: Observed the coconut change position after being touched.
